title: "Four kinds of municipal zone"
description: "k-means on water, services and context finds four kinds of Colombian municipal zone."
date: 2026-11-01
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{python}
import json

import pandas as pd

summary = json.load(open("outputs/summary.json"))
profiles = pd.read_csv("outputs/cluster_profiles.csv").set_index("cluster")
# The title states the number of kinds: fail the render if the analysis changes it.
assert summary["k"] == 4, f"the title says four kinds but the analysis found k = {summary['k']}"
names = profiles["name"].tolist()
```

We grouped `{python} f"{summary['kept']:,}"` urban and rural zone-years from
`{python} f"{summary['municipalities']:,}"` Colombian municipalities, 2016–2023, by nine
features: utility-supplied (prestadores) IRCA, piped water and sewer coverage, poverty,
rural share, altitude, rainfall, municipal performance and water transfers per person.
k-means picked **`{python} summary['k']` kinds**: `{python} summary['k_reason']`

The kinds are: `{python} "; ".join(names)`.

Infant mortality, Saber 11 and dropout differ between the kinds, but these comparisons are
descriptive and do not establish causal effects of water quality. Read the
[report](../../report.qmd) or the [clusters page](../../clusters.qmd) for the details.
